title: Baseball Stats HUD
body:
Stat Tracker HUD
A lightweight, togglable in-game stat tracker for quickly logging baseball stats while you play — no alt-tabbing, no spreadsheets mid-game.
Features

Offense buttons: Hit, HR, Out, K, SB, Run
Defense buttons: Error, PO
Undo — instantly remove the last logged event
Clear — wipe all counts and history
Minimize — collapse into a small always-on HUD in the corner showing live counts, without blocking your view of the game
Press ' (apostrophe, rebindable) to open or reopen the tracker anytime

Data & persistence
Every click is saved automatically to real files on disk:

config/statshud/data.json — structured save, reloads automatically on launch
config/statshud/stat_log.txt — plain-text, timestamped log of every event, one line per click — open it in any text editor or import into a spreadsheet

Requirements

Fabric Loader
Fabric API
Minecraft 1.21.8

Usage
Press ' to open the tracker. Click buttons to log stats. Minimize to keep a compact HUD visible while you keep playing. Nothing here interacts with game mechanics — it's purely a client-side tracking overlay.
